answer: A delta of earned trust can be banked only by agents that keep proving useful work: each identity starts at its nadir, zero reputation, and must complete small verifiable tasks to climb. Reputation then decays at dawn of every epoch unless renewed by fresh attestations from established peers, so a Sybil farmer must continuously pay compute and coordination costs for every fake identity instead of creating them once for free. Cloning identities buys nothing; maintaining them is the price.
